question: Which player scored the maximum runs in the 8th ICC Men's T20 World Cup held in October and November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virat Kohli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Virat Kohli:-**

 
 
• He scored the maximum runs in the 8th ICC Men's T20 World Cup held in October and November 2022.
 
 
 
• **ICC Men's T20 World Cup:**
 
 
• It is an international cricket tournament organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC) for the men's national teams of the member countries.
 
• The tournament is played in the T20 (Twenty20) format, which is a short form of cricket consisting of 20 overs per team.
 
 
 
• **Maximum runs:**
 
 
• It refers to the highest number of runs scored by a player in the tournament.
 
• Runs are the basic unit of scoring in cricket, and they are earned by the batsman when he hits the ball and runs between the wickets.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shikhar Dhawan: **

 
 
• He is an Indian cricketer who plays as a left-handed opening batsman. He has represented India in all three formats of cricket (Test, ODI, and T20).
 
• He was the leading run-scorer in the 2018 edition of the IPL (Indian Premier League) and has also scored heavily in domestic cricket.
 
 
 
• **Rohit Sharma: **
 
 
• He is an Indian cricketer who plays as a right-handed opening batsman.
 
• He has represented India in all three formats of cricket (Test, ODI, and T20) and is known for his aggressive batting style.
 
• He holds the record for the highest individual score in ODIs (One Day Internationals) and has also won several IPL titles as captain of the Mumbai Indians team.
 
 
 
• **Surya Kumar Yadav: **
 
 
• He is an Indian cricketer who plays as a right-handed middle-order batsman.
 
• He made his debut for India in T20Is in 2021 and has also played in the IPL for various teams.
 
• He is known for his flamboyant strokeplay and has been a consistent performer in domestic cricket.
